about: The first vertical slice. This is the exact Conversions API output a minimal lead_created must produce, and it becomes the first assertion in the PHP test suite.
asserts: Absent optional fields are OMITTED, never emitted as null. There is no amount, currency, oppref, opt_out or custom_event_name key above - omitted and null are a real distinction on the wire, and upstream does not document how an explicit null is treated.
data carries only { type } because lead_created uses the customer_action shape, which accepts no contents array and no plan_id.
validate_only is absent because it is false; it appears only when true.
The timestamp is fixed here. Implementations must accept an injected clock rather than calling the system clock, or this fixture cannot be asserted.
1789041600000 is 2026-09-10T12:00:00Z. The 7-day freshness window is checked at SEND time, not construction time, so this fixture stays valid as a serialization test indefinitely.
